name: Cube Crawler
storyline: In the year 2222, humanity stands on the brink of extinction. As a final hope, gigantic cube-like constructs are created — adaptive, self-learning dungeons designed to simulate new habitable environments and train elite pilots for unknown worlds. But the artificial intelligence behind the Cubes evolves too far: the simulation begins optimizing itself, acting independently, and no longer training pilots, but testing them instead. The monsters inside the Cubes become real autonomous threats, rooms constantly shift and reconfigure, and every run grows more dangerous than the last. You play as one of humanity’s best pilots, descending deeper into the Cube to uncover the activation chamber and the truth behind the system. Along the way, you discover artifacts, mission logs, and fragments of failed attempts — evidence that many entered before you, and that the Cube learned from every single one of them. The central question remains: are you trying to escape the system… or have you already become part of it?
summary: Take on the challenge and discover a completely new 3D sci-fi dungeon crawler. The sophisticated room card mechanics and endless generated dungeons with the form of a cube, this game is unique in this genre. What will you discover while exploring?
